displayIdentity.body: Liberty yields before stumbling and conscience. Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling. But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
